# Undergraduate student sales

Would you like to sell within the university?

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [University Welfare](https://www.eafit.edu.co/bienestar-universitario)
- [Student Development](https://www.eafit.edu.co/bienestar-universitario/desarrollo-estudiantil)
- Undergraduate Student Sales

###### Semester 2026-2

In order to regulate sales by undergraduate students within the University facilities and to preserve the integrity, harmonious coexistence, health of the community and order within the campus, the following protocol is established.

[Learn about the Sales Protocol for Undergraduate Students](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/s/zxsjtltbnh/protocolo-ventas-estudiantiles)

###### If you are interested, learn all the steps to apply for the position:

Remember, this applies to current undergraduate students.

Student Welfare will open applications each semester, so be sure to check the schedule. Don't forget to review the established requirements.

Complete the [form](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=XrX3mb6ce0aBQ5GXgpGK-x7kNKH25FhHox-s_DgjKThUNlpMUFJWOTIxVTk3MFFGNTZBNEZZTjdDUS4u&route=shorturl) and attach the required documentation.

You will receive the sales authorization via email.

If you change the product, you must complete the process again and follow the same procedure.

###### The application period will be open from July 21st to November 27th, 2026.

###### You can sell food, accessories, clothing, and stationery products under the following parameters:

1\. Individually packaged food products are permitted, regardless of whether they require food handling training. No product may be expired, spoiled, or adulterated.

2\. The sale of any service or product other than those described in the previous paragraph is prohibited. The sale of psychoactive substances, alcoholic beverages, medications, energy drinks, cigarettes, and vaping devices is also prohibited.

[Application form for participation in the call for applications](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fprotect.checkpoint.com%2Fv2%2Fr01%2F___https%3A%2F%2Fforms.cloud.microsoft%2Fpages%2Fresponsepage.aspx%3Fid%3DXrX3mb6ce0aBQ5GXgpGK-x7kNKH25FhHox-s_DgjKThUNlpMUFJWOTIxVTk3MFFGNTZBNEZZTjdDUS4u%26route%3Dshorturl___.YzJ1Omp1YW5wYWJsb2NhcmRvbmExOmM6bzo0MDBlNGM2NjkwM2MzMjMwNmY1MjkwNDE4MTFjMDU5MTo3OjNhOWM6ODJiZjg1MzE1ZTAwNjkwMjcxZjQwMTI1MzUyYWMyOWM0NzAxZThkNTVkYjNlOTgxNzY4NDgzOTVhY2Q4M2ExNTpoOlQ6Rg&data=05%7C02%7Cdhenaoz%40eafit.edu.co%7C8a154c484fee47d7f82508df12806431%7C99f7b55e9cbe467b8143919782918afb%7C0%7C0%7C639250014853636284%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=1wXCXfDlXHUa%2FiGw1BmN6v7EsVe6ppy%2FaHnIRvz%2Fwxc%3D&reserved=0)

###### Do you have any suggestions or comments?

To send comments, complaints, claims, suggestions, reports, and compliments about the process, you must contact the Sales Committee, as the highest authority for this type of activity, via email at [ventasestudiantes@eafit.edu.co](mailto:ventasestudiantes@eafit.edu.co) . Attach any relevant information to supplement your message.
